title: crataegus intricata var. biltmoreana
intro: Crataegus intricata var. biltmoreana, commonly known as Biltmore hawthorn, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. This plant is believed to have various health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing inflammation due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Biltmore hawthorn include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as heart failure and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of Biltmore hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
